question: What do the goddesses of consciousness do when the divided forms of things are dissolved?
premises: Forceful ripening dissolves the divided forms of things.
The universe becomes transformed into nectar.
The goddesses of consciousness consume that nectar-like universe.
inference: When separateness is dissolved, consciousness-powers assimilate the whole universe as nectar.
plain_english: When, by forceful ripening, the divided forms of things are dissolved, the goddesses of consciousness consume the whole universe as it becomes nectar.
